name: Ukrotitel' Nimfomanok
source:
Adult visual novel "Nympho Tamer" will take you on a wild ride of a corruption, seduction and humiliation. Follow the story of a man caught in a steamy love triangle with three gorgeous women: inexperienced young nympho, her smoking hot mother and annoying ex-girlfriend. Follow through various challenges to climb your way up from the bottom to your very own harem. 

Amidst a severe and self-destructive midlife crisis you meet seemingly pure and innocent girl who harbors constant intrusive thoughts about rought sex and humiliation. Skillfully manipulating her mind you'll reveal her deepest secrets and unleash her hidden kinks. Get ready for a rollercoaster of events that will transform a simple romance into unforgettable,  life-changing relationships for everyone involved.

[From [url=https://bottomlesspitstudio.itch.io/nympho-tamer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
成人视觉小说《Nympho Tamer》将带你踏上一段充满堕落、引诱与羞辱的狂乱旅程。故事中的男人卷入了三位美丽女性之间的火热情感纠葛：经验不足却性欲旺盛的年轻女子、她性感迷人的母亲，以及烦人的前女友。经历种种挑战，从人生谷底一路向上，建立属于自己的后宫。

深陷严重且自我毁灭的中年危机时，你遇见了一个看似纯真无邪的女孩，心中却不断涌现关于粗暴性爱与羞辱的侵入性念头。通过巧妙操纵她的心理，你将揭开她最深的秘密，释放她隐藏的性癖。准备迎接一连串跌宕起伏的事件吧，一段简单的恋情，将变成让所有当事人终生难忘、改变人生的关系。
